english: to make sure to eat / eat properly
usage: The classic caring sign-off to someone close; 잘 ('well/properly') almost always rides along.
Are you eating your meals properly?
끼니 = 'a meal (as one of the regular daily three)', the most natural object for this verb.
Don't forget to take your medicine.
챙겨 먹다 also covers taking pills/vitamins on schedule; 꼭 = 'be sure to / without fail'.
Eat breakfast (and then go about your day).
~고 다니다 = 'go around doing ~ habitually'; gentle nagging to not skip breakfast.
examples: I always make sure to eat breakfast.
Simplest frame: object + 챙겨 먹어요. 꼭 = 'without fail'.
혼자 살면 끼니 챙겨 먹기 힘들어요.
When you live alone, it's hard to eat proper meals.
~기 힘들다 = 'it's hard to ~'; 끼니 챙겨 먹기 is the relatable struggle of 자취 (living alone).
요즘 일이 많아서 밥을 잘 못 챙겨 먹었어요.
I've been so busy lately I haven't been eating properly.
Real-life excuse: 못 goes before the whole phrase (못 챙겨 먹다 = 'fail to manage to eat').
nuance: 챙겨 먹다 is a compound — 챙기다 ('to look after, gather up, pack') in its connective form (챙기 + 어 → 챙겨) plus 먹다 — so it literally means 'look-after-and-eat', i.e. make a point of eating instead of skipping. The dividing line from plain 먹다 is intention: 먹다 just reports that eating happens, while 챙겨 먹다 stresses the care of not missing a meal (끼니, 아침, 약, 영양제 all collocate). Its warmest use is 밥 잘 챙겨 먹어 — a parent's or partner's way of saying 'take care of yourself', far more natural than the stiff textbook 식사를 잘 하세요. Watch the conjugation: it rides on 챙기다 (regular ㅣ-stem), so the 요-form is 챙겨 먹어요, never 챙기어 먹어요. The English-speaker pitfall is using bare 먹다 for the caring nuance — 밥 먹었어? only asks the fact, whereas 밥 잘 챙겨 먹고 있어? carries the affection.

It rides on 챙기다 (regular ㅣ-stem), so the 요-form is 챙겨 먹어요, never 챙기어 먹어요.

mistakes: Saying the stiff 식사를 잘 하세요 to show you care — for warmth Koreans say 밥 잘 챙겨 먹어 / 끼니 잘 챙겨 먹어요.
Writing the polite form as 챙기어 먹어요 — 챙기다 is a regular ㅣ-stem, so 챙기 + 어 contracts to 챙겨, giving 챙겨 먹어요.
Misplacing 못 as 챙겨 못 먹어요 — the negation wraps the whole phrase: 못 챙겨 먹어요 ('can't manage to eat properly').
